decisions.reason: The target’s flag cannot enable gamma processing, but the proposed finite PNG route still depends on unsupplied input-reading and IHDR-validation bodies. The earlier claim that this route was established was premature.
decisions.finite_witness: Proposed: a 1×1 RGB8 PNG with a four-byte gAMA chunk and a compressed one-pixel IDAT scanline; acceptance remains unverified.

scope_contract.reason: Gamma-enabled RGBA8 decoding is an option of the target’s existing decode operation, and the changed LUT code implements that option.

evidence.dependency_reason: The target uses RGBA8 decoding on this context.

feasible_trigger.reason: The parser can store a gAMA chunk before IDAT, but it calls an unsupplied IHDR validator, and the installed buffer reader’s body is unsupplied. Those contracts determine whether the proposed finite PNG reaches the changed code.

evidence.dependency_reason: The input setter installs the unsupplied buffer reader.
The target supplies the PNG buffer and applies size and allocation guards.

observable_consequence.reason: The fixed TRNS flag excludes the rewritten gamma LUT path for every target call. Whether this leaves supported, feasible target behavior uncovered depends on the unresolved valid-input route.

evidence.dependency_reason: The sole decode call passes only TRNS.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete target has one fixed decode call. A gAMA chunk can set stored state, but cannot supply the distinct GAMA flag; the target has no input-controlled flag or equivalent call.

evidence.dependency_reason: TRNS and GAMA are distinct bits.
The gamma path requires the flag as well as stored gamma state.

identity_preserved.reason: Each check concerns the same tuple: RGBA8 decode, gamma state from PNG input, the rewritten LUT path, and its absence from the fixed target call.

evidence.dependency_reason: The target fixes both format and decode flags.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The parser can store gamma state from a chunk.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe links this target to the changed decoder.
